usage: fleet-switchboard [-h]
                         {status,run,send,report,notice,ensure,poke,launch,pending,remind,agents,charter,close-pane,daemon,decisions,labels,disk,whoami,comment,handoff,heavy,impact,install,key,restart,bootstrap,intent,intents,job,prove,verdict,item-prove,item-verdict,waive,gates,gates-check,load-replay,merge-gate,move,orders,plan,policy-report,judge-tool,pr-explain,pr-state,preflight-pr,read,reassign,reattach,reds,retire,review-laws,review,skills,triage,import-v1,watch,version} ...

Route facts to fleet agents as OpenCode v2 messages. Never types into a pane.

positional arguments:
  {status,run,send,report,notice,ensure,poke,launch,pending,remind,agents,charter,close-pane,daemon,decisions,labels,disk,whoami,comment,handoff,heavy,impact,install,key,restart,bootstrap,intent,intents,job,prove,verdict,item-prove,item-verdict,waive,gates,gates-check,load-replay,merge-gate,move,orders,plan,policy-report,judge-tool,pr-explain,pr-state,preflight-pr,read,reassign,reattach,reds,retire,review-laws,review,skills,triage,import-v1,watch,version}
    status              Config, clients, and every fleet agent with what is
                        pending for it
    run                 The daemon: observe, derive, decide, deliver, every
                        poll seconds
    send                Deliver a message to another fleet agent now, by the
                        delivery rule
    report              Tell the one you report to what happened: done,
                        failed, blocked, question (they wake it) or working,
                        paused, withdrawn (progress: carried by the next
                        message, never waking)
    notice              Tell the person about a pull request you opened or
                        mean to merge (shown in their panel; wakes nobody,
                        sends no message)
    ensure              Start the daemon unless it runs (herdr's startup hook
                        calls this)
    poke                Ask the daemon for a pass now; silent, never blocks
                        (herdr's event hooks call this)
    launch              Start a fleet agent (headless by default, or in a new
                        herdr tab with --terminal), without typing
    pending             What is pending for an agent, and why it waits or is
                        held
    remind              A message to an agent that is due later
    agents              Check that the service registered the kit's agents as
                        written (read-only)
    charter             Set an orchestrator's recorded charter (the Chief of
                        Staff or the operator; audited)
    close-pane          Close a pane no record names (a bare shell, no agent):
                        the Chief of Staff only; judged again just before the
                        close
    daemon              Manage the daemon however it was started (launchd or
                        `ensure`): `daemon status | start | stop | restart`
    decisions           What waits on a decision: list it by view, or
                        escalate, resolve or answer one
    labels              Create the fleet's labels in the watched repos
    disk                Disk tools: `disk report` (a bare `disk`) shows what
                        holds the disk, read only; `disk prune` removes old
                        docker build cache and images (never volumes or
                        running containers); `disk reclaim-worktrees` removes
                        the clean, pushed worktrees of retired agents
    whoami              Print your fleet name (for scripts: the gh shim signs
                        with it)
    comment             Comment on an issue as yourself, signed so it does not
                        come back to you as an event
    handoff             Hand your current work to a background subagent: post
                        the brief on the ask and launch it, without typing
    heavy               Run a heavy command (a full test suite, a browser or
                        e2e run) in one of a few CPU slots, at background
                        priority
    impact              The impact hold's deterministic floor (#179, advisory:
                        writes nothing)
    install             Install the switchboard for this user: config, profile
                        pieces, the herdr plugin, a service
    key                 Save or check the decision-model key (it is a private
                        file, never an argument)
    restart             Stop the daemon by its recorded pid (only if it is a
                        switchboard daemon), then start it again
    bootstrap           Open the Chief of Staff in its own herdr workspace, or
                        resume it
    intent              Print an issue's ask: its Intent and Done-when, and
                        the work item's Intent
    intents             Your open asks, one line each with its Done-when
    job                 Run something longer than a few minutes detached, and
                        ask whether it is alive, finished or dead
    prove               Record proof for a plan scenario of a PR, at its head,
                        bound to the plan's hash
    verdict             Record an evaluator's verdict for a scenario (only the
                        evaluator the scenario names, never a writer of the
                        PR)
    item-prove          Record proof for a plan scenario of a work item that
                        has no pull request, at its reference commit
    item-verdict        A tester registered for a work item (by its
                        orchestrator's launch) records its verdict, at the
                        item's reference commit
    waive               The chief of staff's logged override of gates G0 to G5
                        for one PR at its head (a hotfix); never G6, G7 or G8,
                        never by a writer of the PR
    gates               Read-only: the plan's gates G0a to G8 for a PR, what
                        each needs and who decides it. Also `gates mode <repo>
                        shadow|enforce|off`, `gates off|on` (the global kill
                        file) and `gates preflight <repo>`. May add one
                        `shares <file> with #N` line when another open PR
                        changes the same files (one read of at most 50 open
                        PRs and 100 files each; information only)
    gates-check         Is a ready or a merge allowed? Read-only: exit 0
                        allow, 10 refuse, anything else a fail-open. Only exit
                        10 refuses. Nothing calls it yet
    load-replay         When the load alert WOULD have fired over a recorded
                        day of the hourly load series (read-only)
    merge-gate          The fleet's merge queue: may this pull request merge
                        now? Read-only by default; `--pass` runs the gate and
                        takes the per-branch lock, `--release` frees it. The
                        gh shim enforces it for a gated branch (the
                        `merge_gate` configuration key)
    move                Move an ask to another orchestrator's charter, with a
                        handover (Chief of Staff or operator)
    orders              A charter's standing orders: list them; the Chief of
                        Staff adds and removes them
    plan                Plan-driven development: check a plan's scenarios
                        (gate G0a)
    policy-report       Summarise the judge's recent work from the audit log:
                        calls, would-ask/would-deny, latency p50/p95; --check
                        is its liveness
    judge-tool          Judge one tool call: JSON on stdin, one JSON line out,
                        exit 0 (the fleet-hooks plugin runs this; the judge
                        only tightens)
    pr-explain          Print the PR explainer block: a before/after why part
                        (read-only; never a diagram)
    pr-state            One line of what the daemon already knows of a PR:
                        head, state, checks per job, gates, reviews, labels
                        (zero GitHub calls)
    preflight-pr        Run the CI-critical focused test classes coders skip,
                        under `heavy`: one PASS or FAIL line each, exit 1 when
                        any fails
    read                The newest messages of an agent's session, oldest
                        first (a cloud worker is read on its own endpoint)
    reassign            Hand a running worker to another orchestrator, with
                        its current boss's consent (Chief of Staff or
                        operator); --undo restores its own boss
    reattach            Put a detached or dead agent back in a pane on its
                        existing session (no prompt is sent)
    reds                Classify a pull request's failing tests: failing on
                        main's latest run, flaky there, or new (read only)
    retire              Mark a finished worker RETIRED (not watched, not
                        reattached); `--undo` reverses. Nothing is deleted or
                        closed
    review-laws         The review laws starter set (#179)
    review              Reviewer subagents (#179): print the laws from the
                        PR's base commit, record a reviewer's result
    skills              Compare the installed skills with the kit's (`skills
                        check`, read only) or copy the kit's into every
                        installed folder (`skills sync`)
    triage              Mute or unmute an item in the stale digest ('seen,
                        leave'); writes nothing to GitHub
    import-v1           Copy a v1 session into v2 as a fleet agent's session;
                        v1 is only read
    watch               Open a terminal on a headless worker's existing
                        session; closing it leaves the worker running
    version             Print the version

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Config: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/fleet-switchboard/config.json (optional). State:
$XDG_STATE_HOME/fleet-switchboard/ (mode 0700). See docs/switchboard.md.
